da-false-claim.notes: Parts (1) q-integer/Plancherel bar-invariance and (2) transpose equality are mathematically correct; verified numerically [k]_{q^-1}=[k]_q (k=1..4 at q=1.1097) and the hook-length transpose argument is standard. Part (3) is explicitly conditional on a conjecture, not asserted as fact.

da-vacuous.notes: The 'witness scope' theorem is a content-free arithmetic identity (partition-count sum) dressed as a Lean theorem; it asserts nothing about bar-invariance. The substantive theorems (parts 1,2) are non-vacuous. Minor only.

da-circular.notes: No back-fitting: parts (1)/(2) are pure algebraic identities; part (3) honestly threads the upstream conjecture as a class hypothesis rather than assuming its conclusion unconditionally.

da-overclaim.notes: The framing that satisfying these invariances 'certifies' no CPT bias is necessary-not-sufficient: bar-invariance is a necessary consequence, so passing it does not rule out a chirality bias that happens to be bar-symmetric. Block does say 'necessary' (md:26) so it is mostly hedged; minor overstatement in the 'certify' language (md:34).

da-hidden-dof.notes: No free numerical parameters introduced; purely structural algebraic identities.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Each proof step follows: sign-flip cancellation in numerator/denominator (md:43-48), hook-length permutation invariance of products (md:55-62). Part (3) inference is explicitly conditional.
